family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal domain of antitoxin components of a type II toxin-antitoxin (TA) system, including Xre from Pseudomonas putida, MbcA from Mycobacterium sp. and ParS from Sphingobium sp. [[cite:PUB00098292],[cite:PUB00098291],[cite:PUB00093678],[cite:PUB00098290]]. This domain interacts with the toxin component and sterically blocks its active site, neutralising its effect [[cite:PUB00098291],[cite:PUB00093678]]. These antitoxins also have a HTH domain at the N-terminal.
family.name: Antitoxin Xre/MbcA/ParS C-terminal toxin-binding domain
